name: tt-rpm
description: Cycle-level, execution-driven RISC-V CPU performance model built on Sparta (MAP) with Whisper supplying functional execution, so it runs real ELF binaries — CoreMark, Dhrystone — to completion. The pipeline is YAML-configurable across in-order/out-of-order execution, issue policy, execute granularity, write-port arbitration, and bypass paths, with a modeled L1 I$/D$ plus optional unified L2, per-unit logging, stats reports, and Konata pipeline visualization.
